AchievementMinifigs.description:
Which of a player's minifigures an achievement counts for (a completed Lost Creations level,
a defeated boss, a conquered dungeon).

oneOf.description: The equipped minifigures not smashed (in the Lost Creations: in the run; user's rule).

target_minifigs.description:
Which of a player's minifigures a defeated boss or a conquered dungeon or pocket adventure
counts for (the "<minifigure>_<target>" achievements: "Defeat X as Y", "Conquer X as Y").

Champions.description:
Champions' element auras (script 3722 "champion aura random selector"): entering combat, a
champion casts its zone's element's aura (a random one where the zone has none).

aura_min_power_level.description: Only NPCs with at least this PowerLevel (stat 499) ...

out_of_combat.description:
The NPC is out of combat (the aura's pulses stop) this long after its last attack
(tweak NPCBreakOOCTime).

Cinematic.description: One narrated cinematic, played once per character.

comment.description: Where it plays and how sure that is.

requires.description: Plays only for a player with all these tags ...

tag.description:
The lore flag ("Cinematic Flags") it sets, which also marks it seen; none: the server
keeps that itself.

then_dialogue.description: The dialogue the server starts when it ends (`dialogue/...`).

level.description: Players' level (all minifigures fight at this level without --progression).

stun_linger.description:
Players' stuns on enemies (Petrifying Gaze, Touch of Midas, the Wacky Witch's...) last
this long after they land. Unset: the stun's own TimeExist (Petrifying Gaze: 3 s after
the gaze's last tick, as on live).

this_attack.description:
How long "this attack" lasts for procs that change an attack's hits (an area attack
hits several enemies): Berserker's strike, Knockback.

variance.description: Damage varies by this share either way.

Duration.description: A length of time: "1.5s", "200ms", "2m", "1h", or a number of seconds

Elements.description: Zone elements (the playfield controllers 464871 / 517564 / 517102 and DoElementalAffinity).

affinity.description:
Elemental Affinity (an upgrade with the stat `elemental_affinity`) in a zone of the
minifigure's element: its role (`striker`, `defender`, `builder`) -> buff.

wrong_element.description:
A minifigure whose element isn't the zone's gets this buff (the controller's Wrong
Element; which controller each zone used is unknown).

EnemyAbilities.description:
Enemies' support abilities no client spell describes (server enemy_abilities.rs). The
client has their effects (and animations), not who cast them how: the numbers are guesses.

heals_bosses.description: Healers heal bosses too (the user thinks live did).

EnemyHealer.description: An enemy that heals a hurt ally (the Medic).

below.description: Heals an ally (not itself) below this share of its maximum.

heal.description: Health given, a share of the healed ally's maximum.

heal_effect.description: Played on the ally when healed.

npcs.description: The enemies (their looks: every NPC with the same monster data heals).

projectile_effect.description: Played from the healer at the ally (a thrown bottle).

range.description: How far away the ally may be (m).

travel.description: The heal lands this long after the cast (the thrown bottle's flight).

EnemyShield.description: An enemy that shields itself or allies for a while (Skeleton Trident, Space Merc Defender).

cast_effect.description: Played on the caster when it casts.

cooldown.description: From one shield's start to the next one's.

effect.description: Shown on the shielded while it lasts.

npcs.description: The enemies (by monster data, as healers).

projectile_effect.description: Played from the caster at a shielded ally.

range.description: `ally`: how far away the ally may be; `area`: the radius (m).

taken.description: Damage a shielded enemy still takes: 0% none at all, 50% half.

EnemyTotem.description:
An enemy that marks the ground under a player and drops something on it after a moment (the
Witch Doctor's tiki totem), on its own cooldown besides its attacks. With `spell` that client
spell is cast at the player (its animation, ground effect and hit); otherwise the server
shows `effect` and hits within `radius` after `delay` itself.

ability_mod.description: Without `spell`: the hit, the enemy's damage x this (as a spell's AbilityMod).

delay.description: Without `spell`: from the mark to the hit.

drop_effect.description: Played on the mark when it hits.

effect.description: Played on the caster (code hook "charge") and on the mark (hook "onhit").

min_range.description: ...but not closer than this (m): up close it uses its attacks (the Witch Doctor his knife).

radius.description: Without `spell`: players within this of the mark are hit (m).

stun_buff.description: A buff given to the players hit (a stun), for `stun_time`.

Faction.description: A side of enemies (`npc.factions`): its name and the looks (monster data) on it.

Health.description: Potions, health orbs and level-ups (the server Lua shipped with the client).

barely_alive_below.description: Drinking one at or below this share of health adds `barely_alive_tag` ("Close Call!").

level_up_knockaway.description: A level-up heals fully and knocks the enemies around away (script 990, spell 423601).

potion_heal.description: A Potion of Health heals this share of the maximum (script 464: `life * 0.8`).

Knockaway.description: A push away from a point (the client's AreaKnockaway: Radius, Distance, Speed).

spell.description: The client spell that does it (shown).

bag_public_after.description: A bag nobody has looted from opens to every player after this long.

npc_power.description:
An enemy's or smashable's loot power level per its level, when its template has no
`stats.power_level` (the client's NPC PowerLevel stat 499).

power.description: How a roll's loot power level changes what drops.

power_caps.description:
Super-region -> the highest loot power level its chests and quest rewards roll at
(DoSuperChestPowerLevel: Pirate 1000, Medieval 1500, Space 2000, Mythology 2500, Dino 3000).

power_per_level.description: Loot power level per player level (the server Lua: `playerLevel * 100`).

quest_power_caps.description:
Quest rewards (the "Quest Completion Loot Spawner" scripts): playfield thousands
(`4000` = 4000-4999) -> the highest power there; other playfields (the hub,
micro-dungeons) aren't capped.

quest_power_floors.description:
Quest rewards: playfield thousands -> the lowest power there (the scripts' Dino branch
uses math.max where the others use math.min: at least 3000 in 6000-6999).

quest_rewards.description:
A quest's reward item (client template, the quest's `rewards`) -> the loot bag it drops at
the player when the quest (or story step) is done.

share_range.description: Teammates within this distance of a kill get their own bag (m).

tables.description:
Which loot table each source rolls (`smashable`, `enemy`, `champion`, `boss`, `chest`,
`member_chest`).

LootPower.description:
How the loot power level (player or NPC level x 100, capped by super-region; the client's
`gethashfromloot(table, power, ...)`) changes a roll. The live tables' scaling was server
data: every curve is (power, factor) points, linear between them and flat beyond the ends;
none: factor 1.

bags.description: Chances of entries that drop minifigure bags times this.

parts.description: Chances of entries that drop minifigure parts times this.

stars.description: Single stars (`stars` counts) times this, rounded (never below 1 when the entry drops any).

tier_window.description: Entries with a `power_tier` above power + this are skipped; none: tiers don't limit drops.

LostCreations.description: The Lost Creations: how a run goes (docs/LOST-CREATIONS.md).

achievement_minifigs.description:
Which of a player's minifigures a completed level counts for (the levels 5, 10 and 15
achievements).

button_effect.description: The effect package played on the button when the countdown starts.

continue_time.description: How long a player at the exit door has to answer Continue / End Run (no answer: End Run).

element_block.description: The run's element changes every this many levels.

enemy_loot.description: What enemies drop inside a run (hearts only; smashables drop as anywhere).

entry_door.description: The door that opens the "Lost Creations" window (door guid, in `entry_world`).

force_level.description: For testing: every level is this one (`lc/...`), the Gatekeeper's too (unset: any).

gatekeeper_adds_vanish.description:
The Gatekeeper defeated, the enemies its skills summoned go too (unknown on live; the
user's guess: they stay and fight on).

gatekeeper_every.description: Every this many levels the Gatekeeper's level comes (5, 10, ...), and only then.

invitation_time.description: How long teammates have to answer the invitation (no answer: as Cancel).

level_time.description: How long a level runs (the timer).

parts_per_pool.description: Parts per unlocked pool: from, to (each a part of either minifigure of the pool).

requirement_quest.description:
The quest (hash) the entry window requires, "Test your mettle inside the Gauntlet" (the
client checks the journal: story `window_quests`).

reward_chest.description:
The chest a player's rewards come in: it drops where it stands when they walk into the
Treasure Chamber's `BA_TriggerDropLoot`; opening it drops the parts.

reward_pools.description:
The reward pools, lowest first (`minifig/...`): one more is unlocked every
`levels_per_pool` levels completed.

smashed_delay.description:
After the whole team of a player is smashed, before they go to the Treasure Chamber (the
"You were smashed!" splash).

spawn_spread.description:
How far (m) the second and later enemies of a spawn's `count` land from its point, when
the point gives no `spread` (live Monster Laboratory: 1.0-1.6 m).

timer_buff.description:
The client's buffs: the level timer (the HUD's clock), no equipping, no rebuilds; the
start button's arrow.

treasure_chamber.description: Where players go when their run ends.

warmup.description: The countdown after Start, before the start gate opens.

wave_telegraph.description:
Before a level's wave spawns, each point it uses shows `wave_particle` this long (live
Monster Laboratory: 2.0 s, then the enemies; the only pause between waves).

NpcLife.description: NPC life on the live server: life = base[level] x the template's life factor.

factions.description:
Rival sides of enemies in every world: enemies of different sides that meet attack each
other (as well as players). A world's `npc_fights.rivals` comes first there.

regen_delay.description:
Out of combat this long after the last hit taken, enemy attack or damage dealt to an
enemy before health comes back at `regen_share`.

regen_share.description: Share of maximum health per tick out of combat (rounded down).

regen_share_in_combat.description: Share of maximum health per tick in combat (rounded down).

level_caps.description: Super-region (world `super_region`) -> the level cap there; none: no cap.

rank_player_level.description: Player level needed per minifigure rank.

QuestReward.description: What a quest's reward item drops.

power.description:
A fixed power level (its script passes a number, e.g. 0); none: the quest rule (the
player's level x `power_per_level`, `quest_power_caps`, `quest_power_floors`).

Rarity.description: How rare each minifigure's bag and parts are.

Rot.description:
Which way something faces: a heading (radians about the up axis) or a quaternion
`[x, y, z, w]` as the client stores it.

oneOf.description: The most hurt unshielded ally in `range` (else itself).

everyone_member.description: Whether players count as members (LMOxide: everyone is).

free_rebuild.description:
The rebuild time of members (a subscribed account or UseMemberSmashedTimer) and in
`free_super_regions`.

immunity.description: ... and the next minifigure can't be hurt for this long (465943, MitigationOverrideFlat 100).

knockaway.description: The swap pushes the enemies around away (465935) ...

rebuild_by_level.description:
Rebuild time by player level: the entry of the highest listed level at or below the
player's.

cinematics.description:
The narrated cinematics by name (a trigger's `cinematic` action names one): client effect
packages with a CinematicState timeline, the narrator's subtitles TDB 50000. Live started
them with an EffectPackageIIR on the player.

pickup_drop_chance.description:
A quest pickup quest's `dropped_by` defeat drops one of its pickups this often (not in the
client).

repeat_conversation_minifigures.description:
A pocket adventure whose minifigure a conversation gives (the Monkey Cave's Island
Warrior rescue) gives it again on later clears, as a bag, once that conversation has
played (it plays once). False (the user's choice, 2026-10-29): only the conversation does.

spawn_minifigures.description:
A dialogue's `spawn <hash>` that is no quest: the minifigure it gives, straight into the
collection with the client's "You got a new minifigure" window
(`[Give Swashbuckler]{spawn 7LLT 1 m}`; the other hashes are guesses by the texts' words,
docs/TUNABLES.md "Story").

window_quests.description:
Main quest -> the quests the teleport windows (RDB 1000644 `required_quest_task_hash`) and
the Lost Creations entry window require.

windows_unlocked.description:
Every teleport window is open, whatever the story: the login journal lists
`window_quests` as completed (the windows check CoreJournalHolder::HasEverCompletedQuest
for their required quest). False: as live, a window opens once its quest is really done.

description: `tunables.json`: every global number the server uses.

elements.description: Zone elements: Wrong Element and Elemental Affinity.

enemy_abilities.description:
Enemies' support abilities no client spell describes: healers, shields, the Witch
Doctor's totem (server enemy_abilities.rs).

lost_creations.description: The Lost Creations runs (docs/LOST-CREATIONS.md; the levels are `lc` records).

minifigure_model.description:
The client's minifigure stat model (SimpleChar_t::CalculateLife, AttackUtils): tweaks,
player defaults, formulas.

smashed.description: Smashed minifigures: rebuild time, the swap's knockaway and immunity.

story.description: The story: narrated cinematics, quest pickups.

title: Tunables
